title: Graduate Social Media & Content Executive
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of an ambitious and expanding organisation seeking a Graduate Social Media & Content Executive.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate with a degree in Fashion, Creative Arts, Design, Marketing, Media, Communications, or a related field who is passionate about social media, content creation, and luxury brands.

You will play a key role in building our online presence, creating engaging content, connecting with our audience, and helping showcase our jewellery collections across digital platforms.

Benefits:
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Company pension
- Staff discount scheme
- Hybrid working
- Free onsite parking

As the Social Media & Content Executive, you will be responsible for:

Social Media Management
- Support the day-to-day management of our social media channels, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
- Assist with planning, scheduling, and publishing content in line with the marketing calendar.
- Monitor social media channels and engage with followers through comments, messages, and customer enquiries.
- Stay up to date with emerging social media trends, features, and best practices.

Content Creation
- Create engaging content including posts, reels, stories, videos, and graphics that showcase our jewellery collections and brand story.
- Assist with product photography, styling, and video content creation.
- Write creative captions, product descriptions, and promotional content that reflects our brand voice.
- Contribute fresh ideas for campaigns, seasonal promotions, and social media initiatives.

Brand Development
- Help maintain a consistent visual identity and brand image across all digital platforms.
- Support the promotion of new collections, product launches, events, and seasonal campaigns.
- Use storytelling and creative content to strengthen brand awareness and customer engagement.

Influencer & Community Engagement
- Research and identify suitable influencers, creators, and brand ambassadors.
- Assist in coordinating influencer collaborations and partnerships.
- Help build and nurture an engaged online community by interacting with followers and customers.

Analytics & Performance
- Monitor social media performance using platform insights and analytics tools.
- Track engagement, reach, audience growth, and website traffic.
- Assist in preparing reports and identifying opportunities to improve content performance.

Marketing & Advertising Support
- Support the creation and delivery of paid social media campaigns.
- Work closely with the marketing team to optimise campaign performance and audience targeting.
- Contribute ideas to help drive brand awareness, engagement, and sales.

The successful Social Media & Content Executive will have the following related skills / experience:

Essential
- Degree in Fashion, Creative Arts, Graphic Design, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Media, Photography, or a related discipline.
- Passion for social media, digital content, fashion, jewellery, luxury brands, or lifestyle products.
- Strong creative eye with an understanding of visual storytelling and aesthetics.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence using social media platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and LinkedIn.
- Basic photography, video editing, or graphic design skills.
- Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

Desirable
- Previous internship, placement year, freelance, university project, or personal brand experience involving social media or content creation.
- Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Business, or similar creative tools.
- Understanding of influencer marketing and digital advertising.
- Interest in jewellery, fashion, luxury retail, or e-commerce brands.

What We're Looking For
- A creative thinker with a strong visual sense and attention to detail.
- Someone who is passionate about trends, content creation, and social media.
- A proactive individual who enjoys learning and bringing new ideas to the team.
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
- A positive, customer-focused attitude with a willingness to grow and develop within the role.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Salary: 28,000 - 32,500 per year
Location: Newbury, Berkshire
Working pattern: Full-time, office-based (5 days a week)
About the role
AP&C is a full-service marketing agency helping ambitious businesses engage, connect and grow through impactful marketing, from digital campaigns and websites to events, print and design.
We're looking for a Marketing Executive to join our team and help plan, deliver and optimise campaigns across a portfolio of client accounts. You'll work closely with our Account and Campaign Managers, creating content, managing campaign assets, and supporting reporting across digital, email, social and web channels.
You'll also play a key role in supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of client events, working alongside our Event Managers and Director of Events to ensure every project runs smoothly from initial enquiry through to successful delivery.
This is a great opportunity for someone 1-2 years into their marketing career who wants hands-on agency experience and genuine room to grow. We also welcome applications from recent marketing graduates with a strong interest in the industry; training and development plans are available to support your growth with us.
What you'll be doing
- Supporting the setup, delivery and optimisation of campaigns across digital, email, social, web and content channels
- Creating, editing and proofreading content for emails, landing pages, websites and social media
- Assisting with content planning and scheduling across digital platforms
- Compiling campaign reports and helping spot opportunities for optimisation
- Supporting client presentations and internal planning meetings
- Building your knowledge of B2 B and B2 C marketing and agency services as you go

What you'll bring
- 1-2 years' experience in a marketing role (agency experience preferred, but strong graduates will also be considered)
- Good understanding of digital marketing channels, including email, social, paid media and SEO
- Strong written communication and content creation skills
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Comfortable using reporting and analytics tools

What's on offer
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and 5 wellbeing days
- Private healthcare
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities
- Free onsite parking
- Regular social events
- You'll be part of a collaborative, ambitious team where your ideas are valued and your work makes a visible difference, with the opportunity to work on varied campaigns and grow your career within a supportive agency environment.

Additional information
Applicants will need to be able to reliably commute to Newbury five days a week, as this is a fully office-based role. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role, so applicants must already have the right to work in the UK.
AP&C is an equal opportunities employer. Strictly no agencies.
You may have experience of the following: Junior Marketing Executive, Marketing Assistant, Digital Marketing Executive, Campaign Executive, Marketing Coordinator, Junior Account Executive, Content and Marketing Executive, Marketing Graduate, Digital Marketing Assistant, Client Marketing Executive
REF-(Apply online only)

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: Maidenhead (Hybrid: 4 days/week in-office)

Position Type: Full-Time, initial 12 month contract

Pay rate: £35,000 per annum

MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB

The Brand Specialist is responsible for supporting the creation and development of effective marketing strategies to maximise profitability, market share and sales, and is fully responsible for delivering assigned initiatives with flawless execution.

This role sits within the Nutrition Division and plays a pivotal role within the marketing team working in close collaboration with Sales, Medical, Regulatory and the broader cross-functional team members as part of a High Performing Team.

MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES
- Support the respective brand leads in the execution of the brand strategy and delivering on the tactical plan for the year to meet KPIs.
- Support the delivery of activation initiatives across a broad spectrum of the marketing mix including leading NPI projects as well as the creative development of sales and media assets.
- Support the design, delivery and analysis of the media plan, encompassing both offline and online channels.
- Track and articulate market performance, trends and developments in order to influence business strategy, identify future risks and opportunities and ensure the business is delivering upon its growth targets.
- Utilise excellent project management skills to work collaboratively with field sales reps, medical, regulatory, and supply teams to execute initiatives with success, as well as identify further opportunities / defence tactics.
- Support the creation, review and approval of promotional materials through internal systems and processes, including Veeva Vault.
- Ensure all marketing activities are executed in compliance with internal policies, industry regulations and applicable codes of practice.

Key Objectives
- Deliver sales targets
- Support brand plan tactical execution, and internal business reviews and reporting on brand performance
- Project manage delivery of marketing initiatives whilst learning and observing all company and Industry standards
- Support management of A&P brand budget
- Complete associated administration in line with company policies and procedures.

Qualifications and Experience
- Degree educated in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent experience through an apprenticeship programme.
- Experience within a marketing, brand, commercial or customer-facing role. Previous experience within the pharmaceutical, healthcare, nutrition or FMCG industry is preferred.
- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects on time.
- Demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects and proactively drive delivery through cross-functional stakeholder engagement.
- Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
- Basic creative writing, copy development and content formatting skills, with the ability to translate ideas and strategies into high-quality deliverables.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver repeatable tasks to a high standard.
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, generate insights and support decision-making.
- Proactive, results-oriented and adaptable individual with a willingness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- Team player capable of building strong relationships and influencing stakeholders across functions.

Randstad Business Support is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Shopper Marketing Assistant
company: ECS Resource Group Ltd - Agency - Contract
description:
Shopper Marketing Assistant

Bracknell, Berkshire (Minimum 4 Days Per Week Onsite)
18.07 - 20.34
Initial 12-Month Contract Potential for Extension

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Shopper Marketing Assistant to support the delivery of shopper activation plans across a portfolio of leading consumer brands. This is an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to shopper marketing, sales, eCommerce, and data-driven decision-making within a fast-paced commercial environment.

Working closely with the Shopper Marketing team, Data Analyst Lead, eCommerce Specialist and Sales function, you will play a key role in planning, coordinating, and executing marketing activities across key retail channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain and manage the Shopper Channel Calendar, ensuring all marketing activations are accurately planned and kept up to date.
- Support the Shopper Marketing team with campaign development, execution, and post-campaign analysis.
- Collaborate with internal teams and retail partners to ensure successful delivery of shopper marketing initiatives.
- Coordinate with external vendors on in-store and online activation plans, including POS design, artwork development, planograms, and merchandising support.
- Manage marketing assets, ensuring materials are distributed effectively to retailers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
- Conduct in-store competitor and category research to identify market trends, opportunities, and best-in-class execution.
- Prepare and analyse reports using internal and external data sources to monitor brand and competitor activity.
- Provide day-to-day operational support to the wider Shopper Marketing team.
- Manage the end-to-end purchase order process, including creation, tracking, confirmation, and reconciliation.

Skills & Experience
- Strong Excel skills are essential.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- High attention to detail and strong communication skills.
- Previous experience in marketing, retail, FMCG, sales support, or a similar coordination role would be advantageous.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive pay rate of 18.07 - 20.34
- Initial 12-month contract with the possibility of extension.
- Opportunity to work with well-known consumer brands.
- Exposure to a broad range of shopper marketing and commercial activities.
- Supportive and collaborative team environment.

If you're highly organised, commercially minded, and looking to develop your career within shopper marketing, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!
